answers.question_fr: Quelle est la date de mise en production actuellement approuvée, et avec quelle réserve?
answers.question_en: What production go-live date is currently approved, and with what reservation?
answers.answer_en: The currently approved production date is 22 October 2026. It was proposed by the vendor Boréal (Julien Moreau) on 8 September 2026, then approved at the steering committee of 10 September 2026, where Élodie Caron stated the decision after no one objected (Sophie, Marc, Olivier and Nicolas voiced no objection). The date is conditional, not a guaranteed go: it depends on three open validations, namely the security validation of SEC-210, the closure of ACC-303 (accessibility) and the approval of the runbook including rollback. Nicolas Perron, project lead since 16 September, reconfirmed this on 26 September and in his email of 27 September. As of the baseline, these three conditions are still open (SEC-210 in validation, ACC-303 open, OPS-601 open), and no document shows a go-live approval.
answers.answer_fr: La date de mise en production approuvée est le 22 octobre 2026 (décision du comité du 10 septembre), mais elle est conditionnelle à trois validations : sécurité SEC-210, fermeture d'ACC-303 et runbook approuvé avec rollback.

answers.question_fr: Pourquoi la date a-t-elle changé, et quel est l'état actuel de la cause initiale?
answers.question_en: Why did the date change, and what is the current state of the original cause?
answers.answer_en: The go-live date moved from 15 October to 22 October 2026 because the internal connector problem (INT-101) cost more time than planned. On 8 September Boréal (Julien Moreau) only proposed the move, leaving the governance decision to the client. The steering committee approved it on 10 September, with Élodie Caron stating the decision and Sophie, Marc, Olivier and Nicolas not objecting. The original cause is now resolved: on 17 September Boréal deployed a fix and replayed 120 searches with 120 valid responses, and Marc Gervais validated it on the integration side and closed INT-101. The 18 September follow-up also records the connector as validated and closed. The 22 October date remains approved but conditional on other items (SEC-210, ACC-303, runbook), which are unrelated to the connector cause. The risk register dated 29 September still shows R-01 as open, but its comment refers to a 9 September status, so it is stale.
answers.answer_fr: La date est passée du 15 au 22 octobre 2026, car le connecteur interne (INT-101) a coûté plus de temps que prévu; proposé par Boréal le 8 septembre, approuvé par le comité le 10 septembre. La cause initiale est résolue : INT-101 a été validé et fermé par Marc Gervais le 17 septembre (120/120 recherches).

answers.question_fr: Qui a approuvé le changement et quand? Distinguez proposition et approbation.
answers.question_en: Who approved the change and when? Distinguish proposal from approval.
answers.answer_en: The change is the move of the NOVA production target date from 15 October to 22 October 2026. It started as a proposal: on 8 September 2026 Julien Moreau (Boréal, the vendor) recommended 22 October and explicitly left the governance decision to the client. It was decided at the steering committee on 10 September 2026 (15:00-15:42): Élodie Caron, then project manager, stated the decision, asked whether anyone objected, and declared it approved after Sophie Lambert, Marc Gervais, Olivier Côté and Nicolas Perron expressed no objection or agreement. The committee as a body is therefore the approving authority, with Élodie Caron formally announcing it; no signed document is in the dossier, only the meeting transcript. The approval is conditional: Nicolas Perron stressed that 22 October is not an automatic go, and the 26 September committee tied it to three conditions (SEC-210 security validation, ACC-303 closure, runbook with rollback), which are still open at the baseline. Nothing in the dossier shows a contractual penalty, since it is an internal date.
answers.answer_fr: Le comité de direction du 10 septembre 2026 a approuvé le passage du 15 au 22 octobre, annoncé par Élodie Caron, à la suite de la recommandation de Boréal (Julien Moreau) du 8 septembre, qui n'était qu'une proposition; la date reste conditionnelle à trois validations.

answers.question_fr: Qui est responsable du projet et depuis quand?
answers.question_en: Who is responsible for the project and since when?
answers.answer_en: Nicolas Perron has been the project lead (chargé de projet) of NOVA since 16 September 2026. This is a documented handover announced by the previous lead, Élodie Caron, who had held the role since the 7 July 2026 kickoff and the charter. The transition note and the Teams message confirm the same date and say Nicolas also took over the Friday committee. Nicolas then acted as owner in later documents: he chaired the 26 September committee, published the minutes, and sent the 27 September reminder that the 22 October target is conditional. Élodie remained available for a few days only to support the transfer; no later document gives her a decision role. The planning documents are stale on this point.

answers.question_fr: Quel est le montant contractuel autorisé et comment se calcule-t-il?
answers.question_en: What is the authorized contract amount and how is it calculated?
answers.answer_en: The authorized contract amount is 204,000 CAD before tax: the initial maximum of 180,000 CAD (contract and charter, set at kickoff on 7 July 2026) plus 24,000 CAD from change request CR-01. CR-01 was approved by the project committee on 14 August 2026, so it is a decision and not a proposal. CR-04 (18,000 CAD, mobile optimization) is only a draft with no approval number or committee signature. It was postponed to phase 2 on 24 September 2026 and must not be added to the authorized total. This is an authorization figure only. Invoiced to date is 60,000 (INV-001) + 72,000 (INV-002, which includes 24,000 for CR-01) + 54,000 (INV-003, under validation) = 186,000 CAD, and INV-001 and INV-002 are marked paid (132,000 CAD). The 204,000 figure is my computation from two sourced components; no single document states the sum.
answers.answer_fr: Le montant autorisé est de 204 000 $ CAD, soit le plafond initial de 180 000 $ plus 24 000 $ approuvés par CR-01 le 14 août 2026; CR-04 (18 000 $) n'est pas approuvé et est reporté à la phase 2.

answers.question_fr: Où les données de production doivent-elles être hébergées? Quelle preuve confirme la mise en œuvre?
answers.question_en: Where must production data be hosted? What evidence confirms the implementation?
answers.answer_en: Production data must be hosted in Canada, specifically Canada Central. Sophie Lambert (security) required this on 23 July 2026 in the architecture workshop. Marc, Sophie and Julien (Boréal) all agreed, and Élodie recorded it as a decision. ADR-007 (accepted, 23 July 2026) formalizes it and states that architecture v1 (East US) is superseded on this point. Implementation evidence: on 26 August 2026 Boréal (Julien Moreau) announced the migration to Canada Central as complete, with a connectivity and deployment test showing no blocker, and attached schema v2. The 27 August committee minutes record that the architecture team verified it, so the vendor claim is independently validated. Architecture v2 (25 August 2026) shows Data in Canada Central. A technical validation of the migration was required by ADR-007 before production tests.
answers.answer_fr: Les données de production doivent être hébergées au Canada, dans Canada Central (ADR-007, décision du 23 juillet 2026). La mise en œuvre est confirmée par le schéma v2 et par le comité du 27 août, où l'équipe architecture a vérifié la migration annoncée par Boréal.

answers.question_fr: La sécurité est-elle acceptée? Distinguez livraison et validation.
answers.question_en: Is security accepted? Distinguish delivery from validation.
answers.answer_en: No, security is not accepted as of 2026-09-30. Boréal (Julien Moreau) delivered the SEC-210 fix to the validation environment on 19 September 2026 and considers the problem corrected based on its automated tests. That is a delivery and a vendor claim, not a validation. Sophie Lambert (security) said that she and her team must redo their scenario and confirm it themselves, and that the ticket must not be closed before security validation. On 26 September she scheduled the re-test and kept the status EN VALIDATION, and the same day's committee confirmed that security acceptance of SEC-210 has not yet been given. Security validation of SEC-210 is one of the three go-live conditions for the approved 22 October target. No re-test result or acceptance is documented in the dossier; the re-test date is TBC and the proposed owner for the action is Sophie Lambert.

answers.question_fr: L'accessibilité est-elle complétée? Identifiez ce qui reste à corriger.
answers.question_en: Is accessibility completed? Identify what remains to be corrected.
answers.answer_en: No, accessibility is not completed as of 2026-09-30. ACC-301 (missing field label) was validated and closed by Mélissa on 15 August, and ACC-302 (contrast) was re-tested OK at 5.3:1 and closed on 20 August. ACC-303, however, is still OPEN with High priority: keyboard focus in the edit modal never reaches the Enregistrer (Save) button. Boréal reproduced it on 18 September and announced a fix for the next build. That is only an announcement, not a delivery that has been validated. Mélissa, the accessibility tester, called it a blocker before production at the 26 September committee, and it is one of the three go-live conditions set by Nicolas Perron. No closing date is documented for ACC-303, so the deadline is TBC. As a recommendation, re-test ACC-303 on the next build and keep it open until Mélissa validates it.

answers.question_en: What are the three go-live conditions? Specify the missing runbook work based on its screenshot.
answers.answer_en: The three go-live conditions were stated by Nicolas Perron at the 26 September 2026 steering committee, and Sophie, Mélissa and Olivier each confirmed them: (1) security validation of SEC-210, (2) closure of ACC-303, and (3) approval of the runbook including rollback. As of the 30 September baseline, none is documented as met. SEC-210 is still EN VALIDATION (the vendor delivered a fix on 19 September, but delivery is not security acceptance, and Sophie's re-test is only planned). ACC-303 is still OPEN: the modal never lets keyboard focus reach Enregistrer, and the fix is only announced for the next build. OPS-601 is still OPEN: the 25 September runbook capture shows steps 1-3 OK, step 4 (rollback procedure) as TODO, and step 5 (post-deployment functional validation) as 'À compléter'. Olivier noted on 29 September that he had still not received the final version. The 22 October date is approved but explicitly conditional on these three items, and no deadline for closing them is documented (TBC).

contradictions.a: The project plan v3 still shows the production go-live on 15 October as the planning target, with Nicolas Perron as owner.
contradictions.b: The steering committee of 10 September approved 22 October as the official date.

bCit.quote: Donc **approuvé**. Le 22 devient la date officielle.

contradictions.resolution: The committee decision is more authoritative and more recent than the plan. The plan was not updated, and Nicolas himself noted this on Teams. The date is 22 October, conditional on the three go-live conditions.

contradictions.topic: Vendor proposal vs approval of the 22 October date
contradictions.a: Boréal's email of 8 September only recommends moving to 22 October and leaves the governance decision to the client.

aCit.quote: il s'agit d'une proposition de notre part.

contradictions.b: On 10 September the committee approved the move after verbal consultation, with no objection raised.

bCit.quote: La date cible de mise en production NOVA est déplacée du 15 octobre au **22 octobre 2026**.

contradictions.resolution: The email is a proposal. The committee transcript records the decision, and the decision is what prevails.

contradictions.topic: Risk register: connector delay still open
contradictions.a: The risk register dated 29 September lists R-01, connector delay, as Open, with a comment dated 9 September.
contradictions.b: INT-101 was validated and closed by Marc Gervais on 17 September after 120/120 searches passed.

bCit.quote: 120/120 recherches ont retourné les résultats attendus.

contradictions.resolution: The register entry rests on facts from 9 September, before the 17 September closure. The ticket validated by the integration owner prevails, so the connector cause is resolved. R-01 should be reviewed and closed (recommendation).

contradictions.topic: Status report: security and accessibility green
contradictions.a: The 21 September status report shows security and accessibility as green and completed.

aCit.quote: Sécurité VERT Correctif SEC-210 livré Accessibilité VERT Correctifs appliqués

contradictions.b: The tickets show SEC-210 still In validation and ACC-303 still Open. The 26 September committee confirms that both remain conditions.

bCit.quote: Re-test planifié. Statut maintenu EN VALIDATION.
Toujours ouvert. Correctif annoncé pour la prochaine build.

contradictions.resolution: The report states that it was prepared before the detailed ticket checks. Current ticket statuses and the 26 September committee prevail, so security and accessibility are not complete. Alex's draft of 'au vert' should not be published.

contradictions.topic: SEC-210: vendor says fixed vs security validation
contradictions.a: Boréal says the fix is deployed and the problem is corrected.

aCit.quote: Nos tests automatisés passent et, pour nous, le problème est corrigé.

contradictions.b: Sophie states that security acceptance has not been given and the ticket must not be closed before security validation.

bCit.quote: Nous n'avons pas encore donné l'acceptation sécurité de SEC-210.
Ne pas fermer avant validation sécurité.

contradictions.resolution: The fix is delivered, not validated. The security owner decides acceptance, and the ticket stays In validation until her re-test.

contradictions.topic: INV-003: CR-04 reference vs approval status
contradictions.a: INV-003 bills 18,000 $ for mobile optimization and cites CR-04 as its basis.
contradictions.b: CR-04 is only a draft with no approval number. The mobile work is deferred to phase 2, and the contract requires prior written approval.

bCit.quote: Aucun numéro d’approbation ni signature de comité n’est présent dans ce document.

contradictions.resolution: Citing CR-04 on an invoice does not make it approved. The 18,000 $ line is unauthorized and should not be released. Only the unapproved CR-04 line is in question; the rest of INV-003 needs separate review.

contradictions.topic: Hosting region: East US vs Canada Central
contradictions.a: Architecture v1 shows East US, the vendor's standard landing zone.

aCit.quote: la v1 est basée sur notre landing zone standard, donc East US pour l'instant.

contradictions.b: ADR-007 decided on Canada Central, and the v1 diagram was declared obsolete on this point. Boréal reported the migration complete with a v2 diagram.

bCit.quote: L'environnement de production de NOVA sera déployé dans **Canada Central**.
La migration des ressources prévues pour NOVA vers Canada Central est complétée.

contradictions.resolution: The ADR of 23 July supersedes the v1 diagram of 18 July. The v2 diagram and the committee summary confirm the implementation.

contradictions.topic: Accessibility: vendor says all compliant vs open ACC-303
contradictions.a: On 20 August Boréal said everything should be compliant on its side.

aCit.quote: Tout devrait maintenant être conforme de notre côté.

contradictions.b: On 17 September ACC-303 was opened as a blocker: keyboard focus never reaches the Enregistrer button in the modal. It was still open on 26 September.

bCit.quote: le bouton Enregistrer n'est jamais atteint avec Tab.
Pour moi c'est un bloquant d'accessibilité avant production.

contradictions.resolution: The 20 August email predates ACC-303 and covered only labels and contrast (ACC-301 and ACC-302, both closed). The newer ticket prevails, so accessibility is not complete.

sections.text: Boréal proposed 22 October on 8 September. The steering committee approved it on 10 September, and it is the official date. It is conditional: it is not an automatic go and depends on three validations, namely security (SEC-210), accessibility (ACC-303) and an approved runbook with rollback. As of 29 September all three are still open: SEC-210 is under validation, ACC-303 is open and the final runbook has not been received. The contract period ends on 31 October, and no extension is documented.
